 # multiline is feeling fine, but this doesn't get shown because it is

 and(
     gs1001,     
     or(rs41524046(A;A), i3001458(A;A)),
     i3000595(T;T),                       <!--i3000595 is added to prevent matching to H6a-->
    )
gs1002:
# now supports comments
 and(
     gs1001,
     rs3928306(A;A), 
    )
gs1008:
and(
      gs1002,<!--H1 Genoset-->
      rs41442247(C;C),<!--Defining SNP for H1c-->
      i3000812(G;G),
     )
gs149:
# checks for multiple rare genotypes on the minus strand, as this should help to catch errors due to strand
 # [[rs1799807]]
 # [[rs8176058]]
 # [[rs1013579]]
 # [[rs1050828]]
 # [[rs1402279]]

 and(rs1799807(C;C),
     rs8176058(A;A),
     rs1013579(C;C),
     rs1050828(A;A),
     rs1402279(G;G))
gs213:
and(
    atleast(5,
      # These 5 markers are on the 23andMe v1
      rs2032658(G),rs1558843(A),rs17307398(T),rs9786261(A),rs891407(G), 
      # but these are only on the v2
      rs4481791(C),rs17249974(A)
      ),
    not(rs2032658(A),rs1558843(C),rs17307398(C),rs9786261(G),rs891407(C),rs17249974(C))
   )
gs230:
# not yet able to determine phase. See also [[gs236]]
 and(rs8003602(C), rs3783320(G), not(gs236))
